channel.title: Monterey County Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Monterey County Herald (montereyherald.com)

item.title: New study envisions future of transportation in Monterey County
item.description: A new study, the Zero Emissions Shared Mobility Study, is a preliminary step towards making that future a reality, with recommendations for key areas of opportunity – things like expanded public transport, bike hubs and car shares – in the effort to make Monterey County more easily and sustainably navigated.

item.title: Two rescued from ocean near Marina
item.description: At about 4:30 p.m. on Sunday during the Super Bowl game, the Marina Police Department was notified that California State Parks and the U.S. Coast Guard were responding to a water rescue involving an adult male and female. Marina police officers responded and located both individuals in visible distress in the water.

item.title: Democratic senators decry indictment attempt, warning it ‘could break this institution’
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy called it a 'test for the Senate' that 'could break this institution permanently.'

item.title: One dead after vehicle drives off Big Sur cliff
item.description: At about 4:22 p.m. on Monday, emergency dispatchers received multiple 911 calls reporting a vehicle had gone off the roadway and was believed to have entered the water. Big Sur Fire and the Monterey County Sheriff’s Office established a coordinated search and rescue operation.

item.title: ‘Never know’: SF Giants’ Eldridge starts shagging outfield fly balls but focus remains at first base
item.description: Eldridge played 26 games in right field in 2023 before converting to a full-time first baseman

item.title: MST reopens Palm Avenue in Marina as SURF! Busway project continues
item.description: Monterey-Salinas Transit, the lead agency on the SURF! Busway and Bus Rapid Transit Project has reopened Palm Avenue, between Marina Drive and Del Monte Boulevard in Marina, saying “this marks another key milestone” for the project.

item.title: House votes to slap back Trump’s tariffs on Canada in rare bipartisan rebuke of White House agenda
item.description: The vote the first time the House has confronted the president over a signature policy.

item.title: Melania Trump says she doesn’t eat ‘much sweets’ as she celebrates Valentine’s Day with children
item.description: It was her first visit of the second Trump administration to The Children’s Inn.

item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: Warriors instant analysis: Wembanyama outduels Green in final game before All-Star break
item.description: Warriors build big lead, but Spurs storm back in second half of final game before All-Star break
